case_captions.two-sided: T removes the two lower-left tails while retaining all three reviewed observations. I/J remove the yellow tail but truncate the red interior. E/W/L preserve or enlarge unwanted material. The red remains crossing; both yellows remain near.
case_captions.duplicate: R1 and R4 preserve the elongated upper reflection at essentially the same location. R2 measures a smaller bright core; R3 contracts too far. The lower feature is retained as a secondary reflection with unresolved physical ownership. See the red neighbor and secondary detail below.
case_captions.abstention: J follows the lower intensity profile and removes the left branch most convincingly here. I stops at its 18px search radius. E is still clipped; W branches into the neighbor; L retains a notch. J is a domain ablation, not a new independent algorithm, and fails elsewhere.
case_captions.auto-red: T keeps a substantial red interior with a small centroid shift. I/J cut a crescent around the highlight despite stronger boundary gradients; that is truncation, not improved ownership. E/W/L expand the lower rim.
case_captions.auto-yellow: T remains compact. E/W visibly extend into the adjacent yellow bead. I/J remain confined in this example; L adds a small upper protrusion. A large connected region is not evidence of a single bead.
case_captions.auto-black: The strong reflection is much smaller than its historical dark collar. R1/R4 follow the bright footprint; R2 contracts further. A small centroid shift does not imply recovery of the physical bead center.
case_captions.auto-opposite: Opposite-side colored observations remain eligible under T. E/W/L enlarge interfaces and conflicts. I/J shrink red interiors toward highlights. R1/R4 measure black reflections separately; whole black-body crossing remains unknown.
case_captions.auto-three: The selected two yellow observations and black reflection remain separate under T plus R1/R4. The full cue overview also exposes inherited paper-facing and wrong-material proposals; none are promoted. A black candidate elsewhere in this crop has an ineligible peak and remains unresolved.
case_captions.auto-weak: Critical failure: R1 merges the weak feature with a brighter neighboring highlight (5.43px shift); R3 inherits it. R4 separates the intensity basins (22px, 2.53px shift); R2 retains a 25px core. R4 may clip at its basin boundary. Physical ownership is unresolved.
case_captions.auto-same-color: Selection intentionally preserves an imperfect same-color cue pair. The first red support stays compact under T. The second cue lies near a reflection/material interface: I/J wander across neighboring material; J exceeds the 870px ceiling. Its color/ownership is not established.

method_captions.A: Historical compact support; tails, collars and inherited ownership errors remain.
method_captions.T: Native thickness opening; subset of A, no restored rim. Can remove valid narrow material.
method_captions.E: Connected brightness-barrier flood; can bypass a valley and leak through another route.
method_captions.W: Competing intensity basins; marker multiplicity flags possible false partitions, not bead counts.
method_captions.L: Gradient level set with curvature smoothing; may expand, notch or stop at material bounds.
method_captions.I: Local isophote, 18px domain; can isolate yellow interiors but truncate red shading.
method_captions.J: Same isophote, 24px domain ablation; tests clipping, increases leakage risk.
method_captions.R283: Historical comparison only; its dark collar is not a reflection measurement.
method_captions.R1: Smoothed-field isophote plus separate native threshold support; may join weak/strong highlights.
method_captions.R2: Adaptive local intensity threshold; smaller core, occasional loss or neighbor substitution.
method_captions.R3: Gradient snake; contraction and instability remain; rejected moves fall back to the isophote.
method_captions.R4: Competing-highlight isophote; preserves separate features, with possible basin clipping.

role: Human visual evaluation only; never algorithm input. Real leakage counts and precision remain uncalibrated.
